nextSteps: A physical Apple Silicon Mac: per-process Firefox energy, no setup or admin rights. The most precise option.
A Linux PC on bare metal with an Intel or AMD CPU: run `sudo sysctl kernel.perf_event_paranoid=0` once per boot. Measures the whole CPU package, so close other applications.
A Windows 11 PC on a supported Intel, AMD or ARM CPU: CPU package energy, no setup.
Run the CLI on one of these, or register it as a self-hosted runner so issue scans use it (docs/self-hosted-runner.md).

findings.title: Large DOM (1,954 nodes)
findings.evidence: 1,954 elements, maximum depth 31. Heaviest subtree: html.js (1,953 nodes).
findings.action: Every node is re-examined on style recalculation and layout. Paginate long lists, virtualise tables, and remove wrapper elements that exist only for styling.

findings.title: Large stylesheet surface (6,952 selectors)
findings.evidence: 6,564 rules across 4 stylesheets, 6,952 selectors total.
findings.action: The style system may match many of these against every element. Split CSS per route so pages load only what they use, and drop rules for components not present.

findings.title: 20 script elements
findings.evidence: 20 scripts (1 inline).
findings.action: Each script is parsed, compiled and executed. In Drupal, check whether libraries are attached globally that only some pages need.

findings.title: 10 elements with animations or transitions
findings.evidence: 10 elements have a non-zero animation or transition.
findings.action: Running animations keep the refresh driver and compositor awake, drawing power even when nothing is interacting. Prefer transform/opacity, and honour prefers-reduced-motion.

findings.title: 10 selectors with high match cost
findings.evidence: .layout .layout__column .block + .block (deep descendant chain); #block-cms-evo-content:not(:has(form.node-layout-builder-form)) .stretch.layout  (costly pseudo-class); .layout__column > * (universal selector)
findings.action: Universal selectors, long descendant chains and :has()/:not() are matched right-to-left against many elements. Prefer a single class on the target element.

findings.title: 2 of 6 images lack width/height
findings.evidence: Images without intrinsic dimensions force a reflow when each one arrives.
findings.action: Set width and height (or aspect-ratio) so layout is computed once rather than recalculated per image.

webnrg.boundary: Green Metrics Tool lab run: Playwright Firefox in a container on a dedicated machine, warm Squid cache, RAPL CPU package energy for the page load plus 5 s idle, no idle subtraction. Not comparable as a ratio with this scanner's own figures; shown beside them.
webnrg.phase: Visit page and idle for 5 s
